crossRefs.note: He who is quick to become angry will commit folly, and a crafty man is hated.
A good man shall obtain favor from Yahweh, but he will condemn a man of wicked plans.
The ways of the scoundrel are evil. He devises wicked plans to destroy the humble with lying words, even when the needy…
But the noble devises noble things; and he will continue in noble things.
He said, “Blessed be Yahweh, the God of my master Abraham, who has not forsaken his loving kindness and his truth…
All the paths of Yahweh are loving kindness and truth to such as keep his covenant and his testimonies.
He shall be enthroned in God’s presence forever. Appoint your loving kindness and truth, that they may preserve him.
Blessed are the merciful, for they shall obtain mercy.
For the law was given through Moses. Grace and truth were realized through Jesus Christ.
That which makes a man to be desired is his kindness. A poor man is better than a liar.
But Yahweh said to David my father, ‘Whereas it was in your heart to build a house for my name, you did well that it…

translations.web: Don’t they go astray who plot evil? But love and faithfulness belong to those who plan good.
translations.bsb: Do not those who contrive evil go astray? But those who plan goodness find loving devotion and faithfulness.
translations.kjv: Do they not err that devise evil? but mercy and truth shall be to them that devise good.
translations.asv: Do they not err that devise evil? But mercy and truth shall be to them that devise good.
